title: LA Colossal – Celadon Sanggam 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW British woman in her late 30s, long ivory-blonde waves, natural face with a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze clearly covering all skin, fine crackle and soft uneven reflections, black-and-white sanggam cranes and cloud medallions. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Goryeo style.

Pose: Seated in a museum-style upholstered armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch celadon-glazed platform stiletto d'Orsay pumps with white trim.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, soft jade green.

Background & Lighting: Western museum gallery displaying Korean celadon in glass cases, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Cool museum light with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
